captions.detailed: A classic pair of wide-body porro-prism field binoculars, rendered in a matte black finish with reflective blue-tinted glass lenses. The front features large, offset objective lenses housed in wide cylindrical barrels, while the rear features narrower eyepieces fitted with adjustable diopter rings. The two optical tubes are joined by a sturdy central hinge mechanism, which includes a central focus knob with a small white marker on top.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of classic porro-prism field binoculars using CadQuery. The model should feature dual offset optical tubes (wide front objectives and narrower rear eyepieces) connected by a central hinge, complete with a central focus cylinder and individual diopter rings on each eyepiece. Apply a matte black material to the body and a reflective blue-tinted material to the glass lenses.
captions.factory: Construct the binoculars by defining a central hinge structure using cylinders and a central axis. Build the left and right optical assemblies using offset cylinders for the front objective housings and rear eyepieces, connected by box-based prism housings. Create the glass lenses as thin cylinders placed inside the front and rear openings, and add decorative diopter rings with small indicators. Finally, assemble the components using rigid transforms and define revolute joints for the central folding hinge and rotating diopter rings.
